description: Pairing request from another PC (PROTOCOL.md section 21). Same test key and the same real codeProof as pair.request.json: the proof binds the nonce, the pin and the key, not the name or the kind. deviceKind is optional; absent means phone. clientPcId is the pcId of the client PC itself (the id its own listener sends in hello); optional, only for deviceKind pc.
